## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The rename should not land without updating the agent guide's pre-push instruction, which still names the removed `make test` target (see "Update the pre-push command to `make check`"). That line number comes from the pinned diff applied to the checked-out `AGENTS.md`, which is not the head copy.

## Changes
The pull request renames the Makefile's `test` target to `check` and updates the README to match. It also adds a Layout section to `AGENTS.md` listing each file and the Makefile targets.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- Makefile:6 — comments — Update the pre-push command to `make check` — Renaming the target here leaves `AGENTS.md:24` saying "Run `make test` before you push; it runs the pytest suite", and `make test` now fails because no such target exists. The diff's only `AGENTS.md` hunk adds the Layout section and leaves that line unchanged. — The guide states the repository has no CI, so contributors following it get a make error instead of the only pre-push test run. — Fix: Change `AGENTS.md:24` to read `make check`.
